# IQRAR Chiller Van Transport

> Premium refrigerated van and chiller truck transport across the UAE. Temperature-controlled cold-chain logistics for food, pharma, seafood, flowers and more. 24/7 cold-chain support based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

IQRAR Chiller Van Transport (iqrarchillervanrental.ae) provides refrigerated transport and chiller van rental services throughout the UAE, serving industries with strict cold-chain requirements.

- Website: https://iqrarchillervanrental.ae

- Coverage: All 7 emirates of the UAE
